dedupe_keys.name: cde balsas temporales y cavidades inundadas

description: CDE Balsas temporales y cavidades inundadas is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ideib.caib.es. The Hydrological Plan of the Balearic Islands approved by Royal Decree 51/2019, of 8 February (PHIB 2019), protects a series of temporary ponds and flooded cavities. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "DATASET Temporary ponds and flooded cavities" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Formentera, GOIB, Govern de les Illes Balears, Mallorca, ICGIB, Eivissa. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
